    def database_backwards(self, app_label, schema_editor, from_state, to_state):
        model = from_state.apps.get_model(app_label, self.model_name)
        if not self.allow_migrate_model(schema_editor.connection.alias, model):

        if self.old_fields:
            columns = [
                model._meta.get_field(field).column for field in self.old_fields
            ]
            matching_index_name = schema_editor._constraint_names(
                model, column_names=columns, index=True
            )
            if len(matching_index_name) != 1:

                        len(matching_index_name),
                        model._meta.db_table,
                        ", ".join(columns),
                    )

            old_index = models.Index(

**Working copy:** `C:/Users/agent/work/work/django-15695-panel` (the checkout my file tools are rooted at; the driver launched this panel run at 04:30:37).
